Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 99 now!
Synopsis :
Chanakya suggests his soldiers and Chandragupta to take shelter in Paraspura kingdom so to hide themselves in the king, Jagatjala’s palace. Meanwhile, Jagatjala organizes a competition to prove his son, Martand to be the strongest and threatens him for the same. On reaching there in small troops and disguised, Chanakya asks Chandragupta to gain confidence of Martand which will be a gateway inside the castle and obtaining the seal to prove as its citizen.
